scripts.build: pnpm assets && cf build && cd files-worker && cf build
scripts.types: cf workers types && cd files-worker && cf workers types
scripts.typecheck: pnpm types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p files-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: pnpm assets && node scripts/secrets.ts check && node scripts/resources.ts && cf build && node scripts/bundle.ts && cf deploy --prebuilt --secrets-file ../.env.cloudflare && pnpm deploy:files
scripts.deploy:files: node scripts/secrets.ts subset .secrets/files.env MINERVA_DOWNLOAD_KEY && cd files-worker && cf deploy --secrets-file ../.secrets/files.env; status=$?; rm -f ../.secrets/files.env; exit $status
scripts.deploy:test: pnpm assets && node scripts/secrets.ts check --test && node scripts/resources.ts --test && cf build --mode faults && node scripts/bundle.ts --test && cf deploy --prebuilt --secrets-file ../.env.cloudflare-test
